authorization: User explicitly requested CORE Base qualification after upload and continuation of usable T5 edits.
dependency: Verified data-transfer receipt; no T5 medical image generation before upload completion.

cohort.source: Immutable canonical PadChest-GR dataset; all cases admitted unless global same-image/question references conflict, explicit source/pixel admission fails, or CORE eligibility is unknown.

preprocessing.rule: Per-image full-range min/max affine mapping from decoded grayscale to rounded uint8 RGB; no crop, resize, percentile/window search or label-dependent operation. Raw images unchanged.
preprocessing.admission: All channels and dimensions verified by PNG save/reload pixel roundtrip; constant/invalid range fails closed.
preprocessing.scientific_input_identity: Only the newly rendered inputs receive required image SHA bindings for the existing prediction/Judge cache; no rehash of original images or archives.

Base.actual_decoder_precision: FP32 for both Base and MDU; legacy generation-dtype metadata explicitly distinguished
Base.generation: Same backbone, native prompt, frozen greedy config,1024 cap, original RNG; no teacher forcing or answer-derived stop.
Base.mechanical_gate: First fixed query per shard generated twice with identical token outputs

CORE.rubric: Identical accepted CORE/FULL contract; CORE only in reported main tables.

eligibility.followup: CORE judgment known, either correct or wrong; pre-correct is not a gate
eligibility.source_and_token_admission: Five prior-only views; fixed universal token lock; no outcome-based replacement

method.name: Selected fixed MDU recipe, separate T5 task cohort
method.router: Original R0 with fixed alpha, canonical case order and seed mapping; no radius/layer search
method.bank: Only predeclared global image-role-safe subset; real final bank, not average single results

metrics.T0: CORE reliability on Base-wrong prior cases
metrics.primary_T5: 1 - fraction of all eligible edits with pre-correct followup becoming post-wrong; explicit operationalization of paper prose
secondary: stratification by presence codes11/01/10 and R0 activation
metrics.unknown: Bounds for missing method labels, not confidence intervals

resources.model_experiment_clock: One23h clock starting at first actual rendered-input preprocessing, includes Base,CORE qualification,training,generation and post scoring; never reset
resources.T4_GPU_protection: Reserve physical2/3 while the T4 GPU guard has not completed successfully
resources.new_GPU_admission: At least45056MiB free plus UUID check; share only with sufficient memory; never terminate other work
resources.data_job: Separate prior data-build/transfer clock remains unchanged; archives and raw input package are read-only shared assets

delivery: Public code/configuration/aggregate CORE results through proxy; private QA,images,patient identifiers,tokens and checkpoints retained privately.
